newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends higher, halts 2-day slide.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends higher, halts 2-day slide.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks halted a two-day losing streak on Monday as the Nasdaq Composite ended higher in moderate trade.
The Nasdaq index rose 4.47 to 1404.79. Winners beat losers by a margin of about 11 to 10, on volume of 567 million shares.
"It was really mixed," said Patrick Davis, head of OTC trading at Salomon Brothers. "There was a little follow through from Friday."
After falling on Friday due to a warning about second quarter results, Intel Corp had another losing session, off 1-3/4 to 149-3/4.
Computational Systems fell 5-1/2 to 14-1/2 after the company said second-quarter sales and earnings per share will be below Wall Street estimates.

Immunex Corp shares jumped 3-1/2 to 34-7/8 after the company said its Flt-3 compound, tested as an immune system booster, was shown to also be effective in slowing the growth of cancer tumors in mice.
APS Holding Corp fell two to eight after the distributor of automotive replacement parts said its fiscal 1998 earnings would fall short of analysts's expectations.
